lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Jeff put her badge in a drawer
Said, "I won`t need that anymore"
Now the alarm clock lost its fight
We sleep in like kings tonight

Her inbox cried, her meetings fled
She kissed that office life good-bye
Now she’s got plans by the score
Like "maybe nap, then nap some more"

[Pre-Chorus]
No more rush, no more grind
No more fake small talk at nine
She’s a legend, let it show
Watch her joy say, "Here we go"

[Chorus]
Jeff’s retired now, oh my
(Jeff’s retired now)
She can binge and she can fly
(Jeff’s retired now)
Pajamas on by half past ten
And she’s the boss of every ден
Jeff’s retired now, all right
She traded stress for cake and light

[Verse 2]
She waters plants like they owe her rent
She talks to dogs in confidence
She calls the fridge her business school
And honestly, she plays it cool

The calendar is empty air
The only crisis is her chair
She says, "I earned this, watch and see"
Then does a victory dance with me

[Pre-Chorus]
No more meetings, no more chains
Just backyard laughs and silly games
She’s free, and that looks good on you
Even the toaster’s clapping too

[Chorus]
Jeff’s retired now, oh my
(Jeff’s retired now)
She can binge and she can fly
(Jeff’s retired now)
Pajamas on by half past ten
And she’s the boss of every ден
Jeff’s retired now, all right
She traded stress for cake and light

[Bridge]
Here’s to the woman of the hour
Who escaped that paper tower
She’s got time, she’s got style
She’s got room to sit and smile

So raise a toast, let the whole block know
The queen of "nope" is ready to go
From "Where’s my phone?" to "Leave me be"
That’s retirement, baby, victory

[Chorus]
Jeff’s retired now, oh my
(Jeff’s retired now)
She can binge and she can fly
(Jeff’s retired now)
Pajamas on by half past ten
And she’s the boss of every ден
Jeff’s retired now, all right
She traded stress for cake and light

[Outro]
Jeff’s retired now
Pass the cake around
Jeff’s retired now
Best job ever found
title: Jeffs Retired Now
